children: A first-of-its-kind 5G workflow integrates Haivision’s bonded cellular transmitters with EVS’s T-Motion media production robotic systems for seamless remote camera operation
MONTREAL, Canada AND LIÈGE, Belgium, Sept. 10, 2026
, a leading global provider of mission-critical, real-time video networking and visual collaboration solutions, and

, a leading provider of live video technology for broadcast and new media productions, today announced a joint demonstration at IBC2026 showcasing the future of remote production through bonded cellular video contribution and robotic camera control over public and private 5G networks.

At this year’s show, the companies will unveil a live remote production workflow connecting the EVS stand at IBC in Amsterdam with EVS headquarters in Liège almost 250 kilometers away, enabling EVS T-Motion real-time media production robotic and camera control (Pan/Tilt/Zoom/Focus and painting colorimetry) via the Haivision Pro460 5G video transmitter, Haivision StreamHub receiver and the EVS Choreon unified robotic controller. The demonstration highlights how Haivision’s bonded cellular and 5G contribution technology integrates with EVS’s robotic camera systems to deliver broadcast-grade reliability for long-distance remote operation of motorized production assets.

“This demonstration shows how robotic camera systems and next-generation connectivity can fundamentally reshape remote production,” said Benoit Dentan, Vice President, T-Motion Robotics Solution, at EVS. “By integrating our Choreon robotic controller with Haivision’s 5G video contribution technology, we’re proving that broadcasters can operate precision robotics from virtually anywhere with the responsiveness they expect in live environments. It’s a major step toward fully connected, automated production workflows that scale across studios, venues, and continents.”
A Breakthrough in Scalable Remote Production

The joint demo illustrates how public and private 5G networks can function as a unified production fabric, enabling low latency, resilient connectivity for remote control, monitoring, and contribution of critical live production elements. This capability unlocks new possibilities for cost-efficient, flexible, and scalable remote production, optimizing on-site resources while maintaining the precision required for live events.

“Broadcasters are looking for practical, scalable ways to extend remote production, and 5G is now making that possible,” said Jean-Marc Racine, Chief Product Officer and EVP Broadcast, Haivision. “By combining Haivision’s ultra-low latency contribution technology with EVS’s T-Motion media production robotic systems, we’re demonstrating a workflow that delivers the responsiveness and reliability live production demands, even across long distances. This collaboration shows how cellular bonding over 5G can become a true production backbone, enabling new levels of flexibility, automation, and creative possibility.”
The Future of Remote Production
Visitors to IBC2026 can see how live video contribution combined with 5G-enabled remote operation can transform live event coverage and studio automation at the EVS stand (Hall 7, 7.B11).
To schedule a meeting with Haivision at IBC2026, visit: https://www.haivision.com/events/ibc/
About Haivision

Haivision is a leading global provider of mission-critical, real-time video networking and visual collaboration solutions. Haivision enables organizations globally to engage audiences, enhance collaboration, and support decision-making. We provide high-quality, low-latency, secure, and reliable live video at a global scale. Haivision open-sourced its award-winning SRT low-latency video streaming protocol and founded the SRT Alliance to support its adoption. Awarded four Emmys® for Technology and Engineering from the National Academy of Television Arts and Sciences, Haivision continues to fuel the future of IP video transformation. Founded in 2004, Haivision is headquartered in Montreal and Chicago with offices, sales, and support located throughout the Americas, Europe, and Asia. To learn more, visit Haivision at www.haivision.com.
About EVS
We create return on emotion

EVS is globally recognized as a leading provider in live video technology for broadcast and new media productions. Spanning the entire production process, EVS solutions are trusted by production teams worldwide to deliver the most gripping live sports images, buzzing entertainment shows and breaking news to billions of viewers every day – and in real time. Headquartered in Liège, Belgium, the company has a global presence with offices in Australia, Asia, the Middle East, Europe, North and Latin America, employing over 800 team members and ensuring sales, training, and technical support to more than 100 countries. EVS is a public company traded on Euronext Brussels: EVS, ISIN: BE0003820371. EVS is, amongst others, part of the Euronext Tech Leaders and Euronext BEL Mid indices.
